title: Mochizuki Honami — The Kind Honor Student〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me see...
Please give me fifteen apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Fifteen apple pies, right?
Thanks for always buying from us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mhm? Is that Honami over there?
Hi ho, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that smells delicious!
Is that a bag full of apple pies I spy with my little eye?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes... I like apple pies.
And the apple pies from this shop just taste so good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This is very useful information♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Can I have a thousand apple pies, please?!

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: D-Did you just say a-a thousand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, one thousand apple pies, please!

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Umm, I'm very sorry, but we just finished selling all the apple pies we had available...

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
We're baking fresh ones now...
They should be available for sale in about an hour.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait that long...
Ugh... My stomach's already growling like crazy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Soon I will deflate and become as thin as a fluttery piece of paper...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ugh... Will I get blown away by the wind when that happens?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... It was my fault for buying up the entire stock, so would you like to have one of mine?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-If you don't mind, that is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's my pleasure.
Ah, there are some empty seats over there. Shall we sit down there and eat?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here.
It's very hot, so be careful not to burn your tongue.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nom nom! Yeah, it's hot but not too hot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe, I'm glad you think so.
I really love the apple pies here too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah...
Excuse me for a bit, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
There's apple pie crust on your cheeks...
Okay, I've removed it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can use these wet tissues too, if you need them. Oh, by the way, would you like some juice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Great, I'll get something for you too then.
Hm... Are you okay with orange juice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get that for you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The apple pie was good, and you treated me so nicely too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll repay this apple pie of perfect hospitality one day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Farewell, and see you tomorrow!
Thanks again☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been a while since I was able to really sit down and just enjoy an apple pie without thinking too much...
